ISTATS::set
Description
Set the given key’s value within
iStats
Syntax
ISTATS
::
set
<
key
>
<
value
>
ISTATS::set
Set the given key’s value within iStats. The key consists of a class,
object, measure type (counter, gauge, string), and measure name,
separated by whitespace and enclosed in double quotes. See the
example below.
Examples
when
HTTP_REQUEST
{
# send request to /invalidate?policy=<policy>
if
{
[
HTTP
::
path
]
eq
"/invalidate"
}
{
set
wa_policy
[
URI
::
query
[
HTTP
::
uri
]
policy
]
if
{
$wa_policy
ne
""
}
{
ISTATS
::
set
"WA policy string $wa_policy"
1
}
HTTP
::
respond
200
content
"<html><body>Cache Invalidated for Policy: $wa_policy</body></html>"
}
}
